data.long_meaning: Derived from the Greek word 'aldos' which means 'ancient' or 'noble'. In Christian tradition, Aldas may symbolize the wisdom and steadfastness of God. The name Aldas carries the meaning “Old, noble” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Aldas usually hope their child will grow to embody old, noble and live with faith, good character and purpose.
